items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Paul Whiteman was called the King of Jazz.

ctx.x: When Benny Goodman came. They needed a title for him. Paul Whiteman was called the King of Jazz. Here comes Benny Goodman. They name him the King of Swing. And . . . what’s his name . . . Presley, the King of Rock.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Paul Whiteman, everybody, all the White musicians used to go to Pa and Jerry's in the morning to get that chicken that they served

ctx.x: Yeah, he went to Europe and he... He was ambitious. He went to Europe. He was the toast of Europe after Jim Europe.
Yeah. I heard he said he couldn't take it to call Paul Whiteman "The King Of Jazz," and he took his band and went to Europe. He was in Russia in 1923. [sic: 1925]
